# Official PAR3 pipeline fixture

These four unmodified carriers were generated on 2026-09-08 by official
`Parchive/par3cmdline` revision `2971702e501f1350b1c7b9d11369af9157d6ed56`.
The protected input is regenerated by `TestPar3E2E`; it contains 262,144 bytes,
with byte `i` equal to `(i * 17 + (i >> 8) * 13 + 7) & 255`.

Run from a directory containing only `payload.bin`:

```sh
par3 create -s32768 -c4 -e1 set.par3 payload.bin
```

This produces eight Cauchy input blocks and four recovery blocks across three
recovery carriers. `creation.txt` preserves the command output; `sha256.json`
records every carrier digest. Tests only damage regenerated protected bytes
or withhold articles. They never modify a PAR3 packet.

The generator was the previously approved macOS/ARM64 scratch adaptation of
the pinned source: platform/build changes and SSE2NEON support, with unchanged
PAR3 format and coding source. Source archive SHA-256:
`41695d424730bfa4838bada4f2750928f895ff8cf5cb6e6dc81ebe89731c6e8d`.
Generator executable SHA-256:
`8b718420ad68d78c6e4f4ac607e7e8502776f8ddc39b506013e609ca43d2ac62`.
